title: Pulliam Elementary School
subtitle: Atlanta, GA March 24-27, 2026
bodyHtml:
*Pulliam Elementary School will be funding the trip.

Families, you are currently viewing a sample itinerary customized for Pulliam Elementary School. Please note that this version is meant to provide a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As we get closer to departure, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates. For now, please enjoy this preview of what is planned for your student’s upcoming trip.

Day 1: Travel Day to Atlanta, GA

  • Travel to Atlanta, GA
  • Check into Hotel Accommodations 
 

Day 2: HBCU College Tours & Roller Skating 

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Guided Tour of MoreHouse College
  • Guided Tour of Spelman College
  • Boxed Sandwich Lunch
  • Guided Tour of Clark Atlanta University
  • Visit Martin Luther King Jr. National Historic Site
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Roller Skating!
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations 
 

Day 3: Tuskegee University & ASU Tour

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Guided Tour of Tuskegee University with Admissions Session
  • Visit the Legacy Museum at Tuskegee University 
  • Visit the Legacy Museum: From Enslavement to Mass Incarceration
  • Guided Tour of ASU with Admissions Session
  • Dinner Allocation
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations

Day 4: Morris Brown College & Departure

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Guided tour of Morris Brown College with Admissions Session
  • Visit the Atlanta History Center
  • Lunch Allocation 
  • Dinner Allocation
  • Depart for Home
introHeading: Pulliam Elementary School, get ready for an unforgettable Atlanta, GA adventure in 2026!
introText: From stepping onto the historic campuses of Atlanta’s renowned HBCUs to walking in the footsteps of Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr., this Atlanta, Georgia experience brings history, culture, and inspiration to life at every turn. Students will explore influential college campuses, reflect at powerful civil rights sites, and enjoy iconic local experiences that showcase the city’s vibrant spirit. It’s the perfect blend of education, culture, and excitement—an unforgettable journey your students will carry with them long after the trip ends.
